correctness.rationale: For algebraically closed characteristic-three k, n>=3 and n not congruent 2 mod 9, singularity imposes ∂i e3=e2−xi e1+xi²=0 at every coordinate, so all values lie in a common quadratic. Two-block e3 specialization and Frobenius yield support points |S|≡1 (mod 9) and signed (a,b) partitions with a≡b≡4 or 7 (mod 9); all cases are exhaustively separated. Counts are geometric reduced points, not scheme lengths. For n=8 exactly 8+binom(8,4)/2=43. Direct polynomial/gradient enumeration over F3 corroborated n=3..8; the all-algebraic-closure exhaustion follows from the quadratic argument, not enumeration.
